summary: Issue #1751, lane A: reassessment under current standards of the 24 open leaves reached by expanding the cost-6 route ed7c588a to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5) through cheapest verified supports, in the prima via motion and causal-chain core and its naming bridge. Baseline main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. Read: currentness at the GOD_4 root (none of the 24 had a current assessment: 10 legacy_only, 14 none), the dossiers of all 24, context of ed7c588a, the 19 consuming argument and result records and the Lean declarations of each leaf and of the closed nodes they support; legacy attempts ab0f7e3a, f2f06fbe, f4bee7d7, 3efb2e4b, c132609d, d1d58e1e, 0b9ad38b, df5581ce, 1032961a, 0626cd3a, 0b9378da, 09f03f51, 1d0d9d70, 096c30cc, 76b347ef, 30c343f7, 4746eaa2, a330f2e5 and 75c35dd5. No new source was read. Placement: almost every route node these leaves support (c1b68c21, 1e47e6db, 96da1d33, c2880fe0, 97f5850f, f296a694, 777646a5, 0628359b, c85e8ef5, a4d3261a, 079b53bf) has its own source claim. For premise nodes this is a direct option; for c1b68c21 the claim records Aquinas's conclusion, whose warrant is this argument, so it adds no independent option. These nodes stay proved_unestablished on the GOD_4 frontier: claims add warrant options and take no leaf off the computed route. End states: defended primitive for 6b9fedc2 (on the inclusive formal-or-virtual InAct reading), 7b8b589c, 9c252f24, a7d2b839, fe09fcd0 (sourced for MOTION_2 by 849f4443; a MOTION_1 sibling, still to be registered, would be a meaning postulate), 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3, 7c3da33e (the 2026-11-13 judgment reused) and 57552dce (selection stipulation); moderate direct options for 68172f57 and, dispensable, 3209ff59; an open hedge leaf for 0181cf7b, with no substantive objection, derivable from 079b53bf and a MOTION_1 sibling of fe09fcd0 only by begging f296a694 and dispensable through f296a694's stated option; open with a concrete blocker for b3573a61, d791628f and f03798ba (one commitment C*, kept standing-power-agent rival from Physics III.3 claim 849f4443, and a POTENCY sense gap for f03798ba), 8a22ae75 (kept per accidens objection, q.46 a.2 ad 7 reading B, claim 2e18db19; the secunda-via twin of the strong per se premise 1e47e6db, carrying the C* analogue only as the strengthening over its weak sibling 446e3f2a), 6a0b545c (aspect of CausesIn), 6ca87431 (kept reciprocity objection), 010988b9 (no discriminating warrant beyond a4d3261a), 962a9ed3 (ByOwnForm for concurrently sustained forms), f1a124b6 (qualified predication, partial), b3853b1b (unsettled scope, no established counterexample), 1ad18c70 (unselected calibration, transcription-only consumer fcb4b871, belongs to the modal-spine uniting-cause family) and a594d8c4 (missing same-bearer attribute or reference-fixing bridge; direct option moderate). New analyst observations, unregistered and not Lean-checked: (1) under one CausesIn and InAct reading, fbc516c1, 6b9fedc2, 4be9a4ac, c6d6379b, 6a0b545c and 67aa5b5c are jointly inconsistent (under adopted POTENCY_1 c6d6379b is definitional, so five suffice), and 67aa5b5c reaches the GOD_4 root through arguments 90e85f77 and f632c6e5; (2) the respect-free consequent of 6ca87431, with 7ad36aca and 32d77f18, is inconsistent with reciprocal cross-respect moving, which is ordinary under MOTION_1 (mutual telling; mutual heating or pushing by contact, Physics III.2 202a3-7); the bundle forces rejecting one of 6ca87431, 7ad36aca, 32d77f18 or the reciprocity case, and 32d77f18 is source-stated, so rejecting it is costliest; the composition a7d2b839 with lane B's e078f07b has the same consequence, and the same exclusion follows through a7d2b839 from the registered 0566122f, which ede78c78 derives from respect-free dependence (c0d99549, 47b151ca), so the gap is respect-free priority and respect-free dependence, both shared with lane B, which is investigating the same split (in-flight, unverified here); (3) f03798ba with d791628f, 0628359b and an OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge gives b3573a61 for caused movers; (4) bypass B1: 97f5850f follows from 42890b45 and f10d5632 by subrelation accessibility, which removes 68172f57 and b3853b1b from this support; (5) B2: with Moves instantiated as MovesIn, fe09fcd0 (in a MOTION_1 sibling still to be registered) and 079b53bf exclude diagonal moving, so 0181cf7b and 99470e3f hold vacuously; this adds no warrant for f296a694, because every recorded support of 079b53bf takes f296a694 or a sense-variant of it as a premise or asserts the same in-act content (claim 6aac13a9; 8653b123 uses d4a26175), and 892db443 was built to avoid that circularity; the self-motion leaves are dispensable only relative to f296a694's stated option (claims 611e63b7, ca78225c). The standing-power rival's justification is an analyst inference from Physics III.3 202a13-21 and the teacher case 202b5-22, beyond claim 849f4443; Physics III.2 202a3-7 (contact movers are reacted on) points the other way for physical agents and is not assessed. Objections: kept 6, restated 6, boundaries retained 3, exact sense gaps 6; countermodels restated as facts about single interpretations. No theorem, Challenge, claim, statement, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Open: the commitment C* (a mover whose being another causes is itself being moved, whenever it moves, in a respect relevant to or constituting that moving), stated as b3573a61 and as f03798ba with d791628f, with its efficient-cause analogue in the strengthening of 8a22ae75 over 446e3f2a, against the kept standing-power-agent rival; a non-God-indexed account of application to operation is the missing discriminator. Exact sense gaps: the aspect of CausesIn for 6a0b545c (factive versus in-progress); respect-free PriorSimply and respect-free dependence for 6ca87431 and 010988b9 under reciprocal moving (shared with lane B's e078f07b, 7ad36aca, 32d77f18, d85de8e1, c0d99549 and 47b151ca); the POTENCY_1 versus retained-power sense in f03798ba, and the computed CAUSE_1/CAUSE_2 allowlisted risk on its consumer 56175b8f; the MOTION_2 label of fe09fcd0 on a MOTION_1 route; ByOwnForm for concurrently sustained forms in 962a9ed3; formal versus virtual InAct for 6b9fedc2. For a594d8c4: same-bearer derivations of the remaining GOD_4 attributes, intellect and will among them, or a defended reference-fixing account. 1ad18c70 needs a calibration selection, and its consumer is transcription-only. Next test: fix one caused agent acting continuously on one patient in one respect, with no reaction in the operative respect (a teacher teaching, Physics III.3 202b; for a contact agent, first show whether its reaction is RelevantTo the moving), and decide whether an operation-respect o exists with InPotency y o, ActualizedQuaPotential y o and RelevantTo y x r o; first register the restricted derivation of b3573a61 for caused movers from a non-God-indexed restatement of f03798ba, d791628f, 0628359b and an explicit OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge.

current_assessment.scope: Prima via motion and causal-chain core and its naming bridge: the 24 open leaves reached by expanding the cost-6 route ed7c588a to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5) through cheapest verified supports. These are the act clause 6b9fedc2; the per se scope and instrument leaves 962a9ed3, 7b8b589c and b3573a61; the efficient-link leaves 9c252f24, a7d2b839 and 8a22ae75; the in-act support 6a0b545c with the self-motion branch 0181cf7b, 3209ff59 and f1a124b6; the act/potency analyses 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3 and 7c3da33e; the operation-potency leaves f03798ba and d791628f; motion in the moved fe09fcd0; the act-priority fork 6ca87431 and 010988b9; the finite-branching leaves 68172f57, b3853b1b and 57552dce; the composer calibration 1ad18c70; and the naming bridge a594d8c4. Lane B's dependence, priority, regress and grounding leaves (including d85de8e1, f10d5632, e078f07b, 47aff057, 09b88101, 97fa3a0b, 000e1f65 and c0d99549) keep their own scope and are named only as shared dependencies. The 2026-11-13 potency/privation judgment and the 2026-11-17 relevance-bridge assessment keep their own scope.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (MOTION_1; generic InAct with DISAMB-IN-ACT undecided; adopted POTENCY_1; strong per se reading; MovesIn, CausesIn and EfficientlyCausesIn kept apart; respect-free PriorSimply; SELF_MOTION_1 and SELF_MOTION_3 kept apart; GOD_2 and GOD_4 kept apart; one fixed context), the motion core is a coherent, positively motivated conditional route. Every route node it expands except 74eb9113 and 27d15954 has a source claim; for premise nodes this is a direct option that remains, while c1b68c21's claim records Aquinas's conclusion and adds no independent option. These claims add warrant options; they take no leaf off the computed route, where the nodes stay proved_unestablished. Nine leaves are well supported as sourced principles, meaning postulates, conceptual articulations or selection stipulations: 6b9fedc2 (on the inclusive formal-or-virtual act reading), 7b8b589c, 9c252f24, a7d2b839, fe09fcd0 (sourced for MOTION_2; a meaning postulate in a MOTION_1 sibling still to be registered), 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3, 7c3da33e and 57552dce. 68172f57 and 3209ff59 are moderate direct options. None is derivable outright: 0181cf7b is an open hedge leaf whose vacuous derivation through B2 begs f296a694. 962a9ed3, 6a0b545c, 68172f57 and b3853b1b are dispensable through stated nodes or the unregistered bypass B1; the self-motion leaves 0181cf7b, 3209ff59 and f1a124b6 only through f296a694's stated option. The contested load is one commitment, C*, stated as b3573a61 and as f03798ba with d791628f; 8a22ae75, the secunda-via twin of the strong per se premise 1e47e6db, carries its analogue only as the strengthening over 446e3f2a. The absolute First-Way conclusion and the first-being bridge rest on it. The standing-power-agent rival is kept: its justification is an analyst inference from Physics III.3 202a13-21 and the teacher case 202b5-22, beyond claim 849f4443 (scoped to physical motion and silent on the mover's own motion), with q.46 a.2 ad 7 reading B (claim 2e18db19); Physics III.2 202a3-7 (contact movers are reacted on) points the other way for physical agents and is not assessed. Without C*, the relative conclusion remains available through result e05d2976; beyond its stated premises, its contested load is the regress 226c38f6, shared with lane B. Two newly exposed sense gaps affect support options rather than the stated f296a694 and a4d3261a: the aspect of CausesIn (6a0b545c is inconsistent with 67aa5b5c and the core prima via premises under one reading), and respect-free simple priority and dependence under reciprocal moving (6ca87431, and a7d2b839 composed with lane B's e078f07b or with the registered 0566122f, derived by ede78c78 from c0d99549 and 47b151ca). The bundle forces rejecting one of 6ca87431, 7ad36aca, 32d77f18 or the reciprocity case, not specifically 6ca87431; 32d77f18 is source-stated, so rejecting it is costliest. The second gap bears on every route node that uses respect-free PriorSimply and is shared with lane B. The naming bridge a594d8c4 is a defensible provisional identification of moderate strength, not independent evidence for the remaining GOD_4 attributes; its attribute or reference-fixing bridge is open. Overall: both grades are conditional on the regress 226c38f6 (lane B, not graded here). Given it, the absolute conclusion is moderately supported, bounded by C*; the relative conclusion is well supported on its stated premises. Kept objections: 6. Restated: 6. Boundaries retained: 3. Exact sense gaps: 6. Countermodels are facts about single interpretations. These are first grades for all 24 except 3c0b7bb3 and 7c3da33e, whose 2026-11-13 judgment is reused. No earlier weighting is changed and no revision is declared; nothing is established, defeated or closed.

Decide whether an operation-respect o exists with InPotency y o, ActualizedQuaPotential y o and RelevantTo y x r o, that is, whether a non-God-indexed account of application to operation exists. Formally, first register the restricted derivation of b3573a61 for caused movers from a non-God-indexed restatement of f03798ba, d791628f, the stated 0628359b and an explicit OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge, so that C* is one certified commitment. A positive account upgrades b3573a61, d791628f and f03798ba together. An account on which steady transient action adds no actuality to the agent leaves the absolute conclusion on the source-of-esse route of the 2026-11-17 section, which lacks the local moving edge. Formal follow-ups: certify the six-premise CausesIn inconsistency and the reciprocity inconsistency; register bypass B1 (with f10d5632 in sense_bridges for FINITE_CAUSAL_HISTORY_AND_PER_SE_3/4), and B2 only as the vacuity of 0181cf7b after the MOTION_1 sibling of fe09fcd0 exists; record strong_version_needed on e3874506 or build a weak route through 446e3f2a.
